_readme: Hand-maintained. 'events' and 'releases' are merged into data.json by scripts/build_discovery.py on every run. 'seed_stories' are only used when no live feed could be read, so the page is never empty. confidence: high = official/primary source or several concordant sources; medium = one reputable secondary source; low = single secondary source, verify before relying on it.
snapshot_note: Hand-compiled from web searches on 2 Nov 2026. Items marked low confidence rest on a single secondary source. Live feeds replace the stories as soon as the scheduled build can reach them.

seed_stories.title: Mbappé’s Mao remark ripples through his brand deals in China
seed_stories.summary: Kylian Mbappé apologised for remarks read as joking about Mao Zedong. Chinese brands including Dongpeng and Mengniu cut ties; reports say Dior and Hublot removed related posts from Weibo (Dior declined to comment) and Swiss shoemaker On, which recently signed him, has not said what happens next.

seed_stories.title: Winter 2026: single wide-cuff jeans, fur trim, gilded drama and gothic lace
seed_stories.summary: Who What Wear calls the wide cuff the denim trend of the season, alongside fur trim and jacquard holiday dresses; its luxury round-up points to gilded drama and gothic lace.

seed_stories.title: Tapestry (Coach) and Ralph Lauren report earnings this week
seed_stories.summary: The Business of Fashion flags both American houses reporting this week, a read on how luxury and aspirational demand is holding up.

seed_stories.title: India’s Trent beats quarterly expectations
seed_stories.summary: The Tata-group retailer posted results ahead of expectations, per The Business of Fashion.

seed_stories.title: Apple Intelligence cleared in China, with Alibaba’s Qwen under the hood
seed_stories.summary: China’s regulator approved Apple Intelligence on 15 July. Alibaba says Qwen will power it across iOS, iPadOS, macOS and visionOS for users in China. No launch date has been announced; an Apple support page naming Qwen was posted and pulled within a day.

seed_stories.title: AgiBot Innovation Day: AHA3 humanoid platform and GO-3 Preview model
seed_stories.summary: A bundle of embodied-AI launches from the Shanghai robotics company. Reported by a single AI newsletter, so treat details as unconfirmed.
